title.zh: 宣布每年3月8日为整个金达沃省特别工作假日，以纪念其成立纪念日的法案
title.en: An Act Declaring March 8 of Every Year a Special Working Holiday in the Entire Province of Compostela Valley to Commemorate its Founding Anniversary
title.orig: An Act Declaring March 8 of Every Year a Special Working Holiday in the Entire Province of Compostela Valley to Commemorate its Founding Anniversary

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2007/ra_9426_2007.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: To commemorate its founding anniversary as a province, March 8 of every year is hereby declared a special working holiday in the entire Province of Compostela Valley.
This Act shall take effect immediately upon its approval.
